title: Device Fingerprinting Risk Calculator - Check Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your device fingerprinting risk score. Assess how easily websites can track you through browser and device characteristics.
description: Evaluate your vulnerability to device fingerprinting attacks. This calculator analyzes your browser settings, device characteristics, and privacy measures to determine how uniquely identifiable you are online.

inputs.label: Ad Blocker Installed
inputs.helpText: Ad blockers can reduce fingerprinting scripts

inputs.label: VPN Usage
inputs.helpText: How often you use a VPN while browsing

inputs.label: Screen Resolution Uniqueness
inputs.helpText: Rate how unique your screen resolution is (1=common, 10=very rare)

inputs.label: Fingerprint Protection Enabled
inputs.helpText: Built-in browser fingerprint protection or specialized tools

outputFields.label: Fingerprinting Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall likelihood of being uniquely identified

outputFields.label: Device Uniqueness Level
outputFields.description: How distinctive your device fingerprint is

formula: let baseRisk = 70; if (browserType === 'tor') baseRisk -= 40; else if (browserType === 'incognito') baseRisk -= 30; else if (browserType === 'firefox') baseRisk -= 10; if (!jsEnabled) baseRisk -= 25; if (adBlocker) baseRisk -= 15; if (fingerprintProtection) baseRisk -= 20; if (vpnUsage === 'always') baseRisk -= 15; else if (vpnUsage === 'sometimes') baseRisk -= 7; baseRisk += screenResolution * 2; baseRisk += Math.min(extensions * 2, 20); baseRisk = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, baseRisk)); let grade = 'A+'; if (baseRisk > 20) grade = 'A'; if (baseRisk > 40) grade = 'B'; if (baseRisk > 60) grade = 'C'; if (baseRisk > 80) grade = 'D'; let protection = 'Excellent'; if (baseRisk > 30) protection = 'Good'; if (baseRisk > 50) protection = 'Moderate'; if (baseRisk > 70) protection = 'Weak'; if (baseRisk > 85) protection = 'Poor'; return { riskScore: baseRisk, uniqueness: grade, protectionLevel: protection };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates multiple fingerprinting vectors including browser type, enabled features, screen characteristics, and protection measures. It weighs each factor based on research into real-world fingerprinting techniques used by tracking companies.
tips: Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser or Firefox with strict privacy settings
Disable JavaScript on sensitive sites or use NoScript extensions
Install ad blockers and anti-fingerprinting extensions
Use common screen resolutions and avoid unique browser configurations
Enable built-in fingerprint protection features when available

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent fingerprint protection. You're very difficult to track uniquely.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Good protection with room for improvement. Some tracking is possible.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Vulnerable to fingerprinting. Your device has distinctive characteristics.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Easily trackable. Your fingerprint is likely unique and persistent.
